title: DeepSeek-R1 joins the text models
summary:
A new reasoning model arrived while community projects became easier to discover and submit, with smaller improvements to request handling and site details.

The reasoning-enabled `deepseek-r1` model was added. `llamalight` now uses Llama 3.1 8B through Cloudflare, and `p1` was removed from the model list.

Projects missing after a UI update were restored and organized by category. A Submit Your Project button and GitHub issue form replaced the email-based route. Kushai’s AI PowerPoint Generator, Pollinations Chat, and Deep Saga joined the listings during the week.

The text API’s per-IP queue cap was removed, image request queues were adjusted, and authorized image requests gained a priority path. Requests without valid authorization still use the regular image queue.

A lime favicon makes the tab easier to spot; logo variants add color elsewhere. Supporter links without a protocol now open as HTTPS destinations, and the prompt enhancer’s documentation and feed correctly label it Azure OpenAI. The enhancer’s behavior did not change.
